== 30% ==
Answer the following question:

'''How''' menny leters ar thare '''in all the''' wurds '''that''' ar speld '''correctly'''?

How (3), in (2), all (3), the (3), that (4) correctly (9) = 24

== 25% ==
A dress is normally £100 but is now on sale with 20% off. By what percentage would you have to increase the sale price to return it to its original price?

'''25%''' of £80 = £20. And £80 + £20 returns the dress to its original price of £100.

== 20% ==
Rearrange all the letters below into different words to form a sum that gives the same answer as this one:

Twelve + one

'''Eleven + two'''. These two sums are anagrams of each other.
